from common import *
import pickle,functools,gc,argparse

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('year',type=int);a=ap.parse_args();assert a.year in range(2020,2027)
    save_source(__file__)
    import numpy as np,pandas as pd,qlib
    from qlib.data.dataset.handler import DataHandlerLP
    from qlib.data.dataset import processor
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
    from backtest.scripts.maintenance.config_loader import load_config
    from backtest.scripts.train.train_regime_arm import frame_signature
    assert Path(qlib.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
    jobs=[j for j in read(PROGRESS)['jobs'] if j['status']=='succeeded']
    assert len(jobs)==60 and {(j['variant'],j['seed']) for j in jobs}=={(v,s) for v in VARIANTS for s in SEEDS}
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=2)
    processor.datetime_groupby_apply=functools.partial(processor.datetime_groupby_apply,n_jobs=1)
    start=max(f'{a.year}-01-01','2020-08-03');end=min(f'{a.year}-12-31','2026-07-31')
    cache=TMP/f'formal-features-{a.year}.pkl';cache_receipt=BASE/'docs'/f'formal-features-{a.year}.json'
    if cache.exists():
        check(read(cache_receipt)['file']);frame=pd.read_pickle(cache)
    else:
        cfg=load_config(str(BASE/'configs/evaluation.yaml'));cfg['segments']['test']=[start,end];cfg['data']['handler']['learn_processors']=[]
        ds=ev._build_dataset(cfg,'all');frame=ds.prepare('test',col_set='feature',data_key=DataHandlerLP.DK_I)
        del ds;gc.collect()
        frame.to_pickle(cache);write(cache_receipt,{'file':fingerprint(cache),'segment':[start,end],'source':'Canonical DK_I, no learning processors, prediction identity verified against frozenv5 source perstage/year','feature_signature':frame_signature(frame)})
    assert frame.shape[1]==164 and frame.index.is_unique
    signature=frame_signature(frame)
    assert signature==read(PRIOR/'docs'/f'inference-input-{a.year}.json')['features'],'formal DK_I differs from v5 source'
    checks=[]
    for c in read(V5/'configs/model-manifest.json')['components']:
        check(c['model']);check(c['prediction'])
        with (ROOT/c['model']['path']).open('rb') as f:m=pickle.load(f)
        score=pd.Series(m.model.predict(frame.to_numpy(),num_threads=8),index=frame.index,name='score')
        ref=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/c['prediction']['path']).iloc[:,0]
        mask=(ref.index.get_level_values('datetime')>=pd.Timestamp(start))&(ref.index.get_level_values('datetime')<=pd.Timestamp(end));ref=ref.loc[mask]
        assert score.index.equals(ref.index) and np.isfinite(score.to_numpy()).all() and np.isfinite(ref.to_numpy()).all()
        exact=np.array_equal(score.to_numpy(),ref.to_numpy())
        checks.append({'seed':c['seed'],'model':c['model'],'exact_prediction':bool(exact),'max_abs_difference':float(np.abs(score-ref).max()),'comparison':'diagnostic; canonical frozen v5 score files are authoritative'});del m,score,ref;gc.collect()
    outputs=[]
    for j in jobs:
        out=TMP/f'{STAGE}-infer-{j["variant"]}-s{j["seed"]}-{a.year}.pkl'
        record=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{j["job_id"]}.json');check(record['model'])
        with (ROOT/record['model']['path']).open('rb') as f:m=pickle.load(f)
        score=pd.Series(m.model.predict(frame.to_numpy(),num_threads=8),index=frame.index,name='score')
        assert np.isfinite(score.to_numpy()).all();temporary=out.with_suffix('.partial');score.to_pickle(temporary);temporary.replace(out)
        outputs.append({'variant':j['variant'],'job_id':j['job_id'],'seed':j['seed'],'session':j['session'],'model':record['model'],'prediction_part':fingerprint(out)});del m,score;gc.collect()
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'inference-{a.year}.json',{'year':a.year,'segment':[start,end],'formal_DK_I':True,'feature_signature':signature,'baseline_exact_replay':checks,'predictions':outputs})
    print('inferred',a.year,len(frame),'rows',len(outputs),'specialists; five baseline replays recorded',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
